title: Performance Friendly
description: This improves graphics to look like the trailers, along with performance boosts and some extras
body:
This modpack is one of the best for trailer visuals and game improvements!
It adds performance boosts with Sodium, The Bare Bones pack for trailer visuals,
and so much more!
Note: PLEASE put on all the resource packs and don't update ANYTHING for everything to work properly. (except fresh textures if you see it)
